name: AmericasNLP 2021 - Aymara-Spanish
description: Parallel Aymara-Spanish text from the 2021 Shared Task on Open Machine Translation. Training data originates from Global Voices via OPUS; development and test pairs originate from AmericasNLI translations of Spanish XNLI.

metadata.notes: Scope restricted to development/test; train variety remains unknown. Source file code aym is preserved.

license.notes: No unambiguous license covering these combined train/dev/test files was established from the official repository documentation. Original sources differ by split. Public availability and requests to cite are not permission grants; verify conditions with the providers before reuse.

provenance.source_name: AmericasNLP 2021 Shared Task on Open Machine Translation
provenance.citation: Mager et al. (2021), Findings of the AmericasNLP 2021 Shared Task on Open Machine Translation for Indigenous Languages of the Americas. https://aclanthology.org/2021.americasnlp-1.23/
provenance.notes: Catalog documentation reviewed; corpus not retrieved. Train: Global Voices via OPUS (Tiedemann, 2012). Dev/test: AmericasNLI from Spanish XNLI; see organizer paper sections 3.1 and 3.2.

citation: Mager et al. (2021), https://aclanthology.org/2021.americasnlp-1.23/; Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS, https://aclanthology.org/L12-1246/.

metadata.format: UTF-8 text, one sentence per line, aligned file pairs without headers
